description: The Paxie.Matrix desk's closed trades on Solana and Robinhood Chain since a time, for auditing its track record: book (main or explore), mode (paper = simulated fills on live prices, no real money), desk and lane, token, open and close times, return on cost with fees, peak gain and exit reason. Random-twin baseline desks are excluded. Aggregates are free at /v1/desk/stats. Data rewritten every 60 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 10 min. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

since.description: Closed at or after: epoch ms or ISO 8601 (default 24 h ago)
